data.name: Break_In
data.detailed_description:
What is Break_In?


Break_In is a base-building/FPS game where the main aim is to amass the largest amount of money you can, and invest it in defenses, traps, and other security measures to protect the rest of your stash. To do this, you will raid other players' bases and steal directly from their account.

  • Build up the defenses on your own safe house to deter other players.
  • Attack other players' safe houses and try to make it past their defenses.
  • Progress through different types of safe house as you make more and more money.
  • Upgrade your own abilities, skills and weapons as you make money.
  • No subscription fees, no pay to win, no microtransactions.

Key Features



Although it is very early days, I have a lot of ideas for where I want to go with Break_In. You can expect regular updates on this!

Dynamic



The main strength of Break_In comes from the customization. With a range of bases to take down, and the variety of defenses available for each base, you will very rarely have the same experience twice. Player A may have a handful of badly equipped thugs, while Player B could have highly trained guards, lasers, cameras, and even traps. Every experience will be different and keep you on your toes.

Progression



With Break_In you will start out with next to nothing, just a tiny shack of a safe house and your pistol. You will need to break into other players' bases to take their cash. You will then be able to use this cash to upgrade your own safe house, buy a new safe house, install security measures, hire security, buy new weapons, and much more. And when someone does attempt to break into your safe house, and falls victim to your well positioned camera and backup squad, you'll be notified and receive a percentage of their cash.

No pay2win, no microtransactions, no subscriptions or additional costs.



Goes without saying, really. I have zero intention for Break_In to go this way. Obviously I won't rule out future expansions, but I can promise right now that if the day comes when this project is ready for expansion, it will be sensibly priced and provide a lot of content.

reviews.review:
What do I think of Break_In?

Well... I will do what I usually do and describe my experience within the game. 

Ive been playing this during the pre-alpha stages (from the demo up) and I have seen the placeholder weapons go to good looking pieces of art. But more importantly I have felt the joy and challange of trying to get enough money to buy the next safe house, and upgrade my gear. After 3 hours of constant heisting (suprisingly for an Early Access this was very stable) I neared my goal of a cabin in the woods.... Then the developer comes on for some "testing"... Whose base does he use for the testing... thats right mine... I come back with next to no money left I cry for a bit and ask the developer if he has been the one raiding my base...

Turns out he had been... Armed with this knowledge (and thats about it seeing as I couldnt afford the supressed pistol I begin a series of raids on the developers base... This goes really well I got up to almost $28 000, then he added land mines to the game... Being blissfully unaware I have probably died too many times to those damn land mines and I slowly gave all the money I stole back... after 10 hours of playing how much money do I have? Dont ask!

... $86....

Not 86K

$86...

I Love this game's idea and potential, I also love it at the moment it is a Early Access in the spirit of Prison Architect or Kerbal Space Program, where the game is rapidly developed and is most definatly playable (even though both of those had a team and the Developer here is working alone)

My only problem with him is that in our many discussions he has not yet figured out the point of DLCs... he has this weird idea that they are meant to be expansions on the finished game... Not little things that make the game playable or that provide one or two features... This focus on a good game over income and on customer satisfaction make me think this guy is one of the good ones. 

I hope you can give this game a go an please if I rob your base... its cause im poor, I have a family to feed.

10/10
Since you have no proof of my failed base raids.

Edit 21/09/2016: 
Craig: enjoy the landmines xxx
Lord Fury: they are my bffs
Lord Fury: cant seperate us
Craig: wait I'll go in and place more than the game allows just for you

This kind of developer taking the time to enrich your gaming is very rare to come by and I honestly have never seen this kind of 1-1 approach before.

It is really impressive and I feel like I should file for harrassment charges :'(. 

Please buy this game and raid his base for me make him feel pain!!!
